items.title: Overview
items.description: Every component at a glance.

items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box that toggles between checked and not checked, with sizes, states and every field feature.

items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input with a filtered list of suggestions: groups, multiple picks as chips, a clear button, server search.

items.title: Field
items.description: Labels, help text and messages for controls; inline, responsive and grid forms.

items.title: Input
items.description: Text inputs, textareas, selects and file pickers with every state.

items.title: Input group
items.description: Icons, text, buttons, menus and spinners inside an input's border.

items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in a row of slots: digits or letters, groups, paste and SMS autofill, sizes and states.

items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label for any control, wrapping checkboxes and radios, or as a choice card.

items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field with a show / hide toggle: eye icon or text, a checkbox, Caps Lock warning, every input state.

items.title: Radio group
items.description: Radio buttons as cards or inline rows: one choice of a few, submitting with the form.

items.title: Select
items.description: A list of options in a popup opened from a button: searchable, keyboard driven, styled like an input.

items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value, a range or several values on a track: native range inputs, vertical too, with every form state.

items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies at once: a sliding track on a real checkbox, no JavaScript.

items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that grows as you type: field, character count, every state, and Ctrl/⌘+Enter to submit.

items.title: Button
items.description: Actions in every variant, size and state, including loading.

items.title: Button group
items.description: Join buttons, inputs and menus: split buttons, toolbars, vertical groups.

items.title: Clipboard
items.description: Copy buttons and copy tags that work on every browser: icon, label or both, a green tick when copied, every button variant and size.

items.title: Command
items.description: A command menu for search and quick actions: filtering, keyboard, groups, shortcuts, inline or in a ⌘K dialog.

items.title: Dropdown
items.description: A menu of links, actions and options that opens from a button, with checkbox and radio items, shortcuts and submenus.

items.title: Menubar
items.description: A persistent row of menus, as in desktop apps: submenus, checkbox and radio items, icons and shortcuts.

items.title: Scroll button
items.description: A floating button that jumps back to the bottom or top of a container or the page.

items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button, on or off, in any button style.

items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons: pick one, at most one, or many.

items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current page: custom separators, dropdowns, and collapsing to an ellipsis when space runs out.

items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site's main navigation: links, and buttons that open panels of links, from simple lists to mega menus.

items.title: Pagination
items.description: Links to the pages of a long list, with previous and next, page numbers or icons only.

items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Composable app navigation: groups, menus, badges and actions, collapsing to icons or off-canvas, with a mobile panel.

items.title: Tabs
items.description: Layered panels shown one at a time: line, pill and outline styles, icons, disabled tabs, vertical, synced and remembered.

items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts with important content and waits for an answer: small size, media and destructive actions.

items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page or another dialog: close button or outside click, scrolling content, sticky footer, htmx fragments.

items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel on an edge of the screen that can be swiped away: four directions, a handle, nested drawers, a responsive dialog.

items.title: Hover card
items.description: A card that previews what is behind a link when a mouse rests on it or the link gets keyboard focus.

items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel of rich content that opens from a button: a header, alignment, and forms.

items.title: Sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from an edge of the screen: four sides, sizes, scrolling content, htmx fragments.

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus, on any side, with no JavaScript needed to show it.

items.title: Alert
items.description: Callouts for info, success, warnings and errors.

items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status labels and counters.

items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state with an icon, a message and a way forward.

items.title: Loader
items.description: Pure-CSS loading indicators: dots, waves, pulses and animated text.

items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar showing how far a task has got, with an optional label, value and help text.

items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders shaped like loading content: any shape, text, avatars, cards, lists, tables and forms.

items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator from any icon or pure CSS; works in buttons, badges and inputs.

items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacking, swipeable notifications: success, info, warning, error and loading, actions, promises and server toasts.

items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked headings that reveal sections; one or many open, no JavaScript.

items.title: Card
items.description: Header, content and footer, with media, an action slot and scrolling content.

items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides that drag, swipe and snap with momentum (Embla): item sizes, spacing, vertical, options and plugins.

items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A button that shows and hides a panel: extra settings, nested file trees, or <details> with no JavaScript.

items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical line between content, semantic or purely visual.

items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image with a fallback for a user: sizes, status badges, groups with a count, and menu triggers.

items.title: Item
items.description: A row of content with media, a title, a description and actions, alone or in a list.

items.title: Table
items.description: Readable data tables with optional hover rows.

items.title: Code block
items.description: Highlighted source with a copy button and package-manager tabs.

items.title: Icon
items.description: SVG icons inlined at build time, or linked as images.

items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys and shortcuts, on their own or in buttons, tooltips and input groups.

items.title: Text
items.description: Long-form content with .prose (Tailwind Typography), plus helpers for single elements.

items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file, image, video or audio attachment with upload states, sizes, orientation and scrolling groups.

items.title: Chain of thought
items.description: A sequence of steps on a connecting line, each folding its details away: reasoning traces, tool calls and process logs.

items.title: Message
items.description: A chat message with avatar, header, footer and alignment; groups, attachments, and reasoning and tool calls for AI chat.

items.title: Message scroller
items.description: Scrolling for a streaming chat transcript: new questions rise to the top, replies grow beneath them, and the view moves only when the reader does.

items.title: Prompt input
items.description: The text box of an AI chat: a growing textarea, tools, send and stop, @ mentions and / commands.

items.title: Reasoning
items.description: A collapsible for AI reasoning that opens while it streams and closes, with its duration, when it ends.
